purpose: Manual image-space observations for a camera baseline and later visible-boundary comparison; no geometry modification or physical measurement.

image.camera_metadata: No EXIF available in the supplied PNG; focal length, sensor, distortion and crop are unknown.
image.view: Perspective side-rear product view, not an orthographic side view.
image.same_specimen_status: Not proved to be the same physical specimen as the front/close-up reference set; do not infer a serial number or communications configuration.

coordinate_convention.origin: top-left of the original unresized image

method.passes: Two manual visual rereads of the same original image with original-coordinate grid/crop helpers. Pass B was re-estimated rather than copied; same annotator and source, so the passes are not independent observers.
method.independence_limit: Repeat annotations estimate marking sensitivity only; they are not two humans, two independent participants, photogrammetric calibration or an accuracy guarantee.
method.confidence_semantics: Relative visual marking confidence in [0,1], not a calibrated probability.
method.uncertainty_semantics: Radius/band in image pixels includes visual ambiguity and marking sensitivity; not a measured manufacturing tolerance, 3D error or statistical confidence interval.
method.landmark_aggregate: Mean of the two manual coordinates; repeat distance records pass-to-pass disagreement.
method.temporary_helpers: Only tmp/sl17b-v4-camera/side-* local grid crops were generated; no manufacturer pixels are included in this JSON.

No model-name or mesh-object match is asserted by these image annotations.
